review_candidates.description: Senior Network Engineer - Up to £60k Salary - Hybrid working across Shrewsbury & Telford We’re looking for an experienced Senior Network Engineer to join a large, complex enterprise environment, taking technical ownership across networking, security and telephony infrastructure. This is a genuine hands-on senior engineering role combining technical leadership, architecture and project ownership with day-to-day engineering. You’ll have support from junior colleagues, but we’re looking for someone who is comfortable getting into the detail — personally configuring hardware, troubleshooting complex technical issues and independently taking projects from discovery through to successful delivery. You’ll act as a senior technical authority across the network and telephony estate, identifying issues and designing practical solutions across enterprise LAN, WAN, security and voice environments . You’ll independently lead multiple network and telephony projects through to completion, taking ownership of technical design, configuration, implementation and troubleshooting while carefully managing deployment risks within a high-consequence clinical environment . Alongside remaining hands-on, you’ll provide technical leadership to junior engineers, delegate and manage technical tasks, and help upskill permanent members of the team throughout migrations and infrastructure changes. You should be comfortable moving between technical strategy, architecture and hands-on engineering , with the ability to uncover problems, determine the right solution and then personally drive that solution through to implementation. We’re particularly interested in engineers who have worked within large, complex or highly regulated environments , where resilience, change management and minimising operational risk are critical.

review_candidates.description: Brebr.io biedt haar diensten aan een grote en groeiende klantenkring, met een klein maar slagvaardig team op de achtergrond. Voor deze organisatie zijn we op zoek naar een allround IT Systems Engineer die het voortouw neemt in het beheer van de Microsoft Azure- en IT-systeemomgeving, en die de IT Director bijstaat in de dagelijkse gang van zaken. In deze rol houd jij je bezig met het beheren en optimaliseren van onze IT-systemen en infrastructuur, waarbij Azure de spil vormt. Je waakt over de stabiliteit, security en schaalbaarheid van het geheel, levert input op architectuurniveau en zorgt ervoor dat alles blijft draaien zoals het hoort, binnen een organisatie waar korte lijnen en directe impact vanzelfsprekend zijn. Jouw rol Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren en verder ontwikkelen van onze Microsoft Azure-omgeving en het bredere IT-landschap. Denk aan architectuur, stabiliteit, beveiliging en schaalbaarheid. Je werkt nauw samen met de IT Director en bent zijn steun en toeverlaat in de dagelijkse operatie. Je houdt zelfstandig het overzicht en schakelt soepel met collega's, developers en externe partijen. Op SQL-gebied (SQL Server, T-SQL) ben je een serieuze sparringpartner voor het developmentteam: van queries tot datastructuren en databasevraagstukken. IT-tickets pak je op, beoordeel je op prioriteit, zet je door waar nodig en volg je op tot ze afgerond zijn. Systeembeheer binnen Microsoft Entra ID hoort bij je takenpakket: gebruikers, groepen, rechten, MFA en Conditional Access. Ook werkplekbeheer valt onder je verantwoordelijkheid als onderdeel van het geheel. Je stuurt leveranciers aan die onze systemen en werkplekapparatuur leveren. Zie je ruimte voor verbetering in de IT-omgeving? Dan pak je dat zelf op. Wat we in jou zoeken Must-haves Een zelfstandige instelling en eigenaarschap over je werk. Werkervaring als IT Systeembeheerder, Systems Engineer of in een vergelijkbare allround IT-functie, waarbij je affiniteit hebt met Azure en systeemarchitectuur. Kennis van en ervaring met Microsoft Entra ID (beheer van gebruikers, groepen, toegang, MFA en Conditional Access). Feeling met SQL en SQL Server. Bekend met Windows-werkplekken en Microsoft 365. Communicatief sterk. Een dienstverlenende houding en oplossingsgericht denken. Pré's Praktische ervaring met T-SQL (queries, joins, views). Gewerkt met hybride Azure-setups. Bekend met Jira en Confluence. Kennis van security- en compliance-principes zoals least privilege en GDPR. Ervaring in het aansturen van leveranciers. Wat wij bieden Een veelzijdige IT-functie met veel ruimte voor eigen verantwoordelijkheid, waarin systeembeheer, Azure en samenwerking met developers samenkomen. Autonomie binnen een compact team waar jouw impact direct zichtbaar is. Een informele werksfeer met korte communicatielijnen. Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen via opleidingen en certificeringen. Een marktconform salaris, hybride werken en een werkweek van 32 tot 40 uur. De procedure bestaat uit minimaal twee gesprekken. Heb je vragen? Neem gerust contact op met Micheal van Dijk via micheal.van.dijk@dijktalentpartners.nl of WhatsApp: +31 6 18475352.

review_candidates.title: Nätverksspecialist inom IP och transmission
review_candidates.description: IP-nätverk | Routing och switching | Kvalificerad felsökning | Transmission Vill du arbeta med IP och transmission i robusta kommunikationsmiljöer? Du har en stabil praktisk grund inom IP-nätverk och erfarenhet av routing, switching, konfigurering och teknisk felsökning. Nu vill du ta ett större tekniskt ansvar och bredda din kompetens inom transmission och fysisk telekominfrastruktur. Vi söker en Nätverksspecialist inom IP och transmission till FMTIS i Bålsta. Du arbetar med att förbereda, konfigurera, kvalitetssäkra och driftsätta robusta nätverks- och kommunikationslösningar. Rollen omfattar även transmission och samband mellan IP-nätverket och den underliggande infrastrukturen. Du behöver inte vara specialist inom både IP och transmission. Det viktiga är att du kan bidra självständigt inom IP-nätverk och har intresse och förmåga att utveckla en bredare kompetens inom transmission. Hos oss blir din tekniska kompetens en del av säkra och robusta kommunikationslösningar som har betydelse för Försvarsmaktens verksamhet och Sveriges försvarsförmåga. Varför den här rollen? Det här är en möjlighet för dig som vill arbeta kvalificerat med IP-nätverk och samtidigt utveckla din förståelse för hela kommunikationskedjan. Du kommer till en tekniskt komplex miljö där lösningarna behöver vara säkra, tillgängliga och robusta. För att skapa fungerande kommunikation behöver du kunna analysera hur routing, switching, nätsegmentering, redundans, förbindelser och transmissionslösningar samverkar. Rollen omfattar mer än löpande nätverksdrift. Du tar tekniskt ansvar för lösningen genom konfigurering, kvalitetssäkring, tekniska kontroller, driftsättning och dokumenterad överlämning till driftorganisationen. Du får använda din befintliga kompetens inom IP, routing, switching och felsökning från början. Genom praktiskt arbete, kunskapsutbyte och planerad kompetensutveckling får du även möjlighet att fördjupa din förståelse för exempelvis fiber, optik, kapacitet och redundanta kommunikationsvägar. Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter Som Nätverksspecialist arbetar du med att skapa de tekniska förutsättningarna för nya och förändrade nätverks- och kommunikationslösningar. Du planerar och förbereder tekniska lösningar samt samverkar med interna tekniker och externa leverantörer när nya nätverksplatser etableras eller befintliga lösningar förändras. En central del av arbetet är att konfigurera nätverks- och kommunikationsutrustning, ofta på distans från kontoret. Du arbetar bland annat med routing, switching, VLAN, IP-adressering, nätsegmentering och redundans. Du genomför tekniska kontroller, kvalitetssäkrar lösningen och medverkar vid driftsättning. När arbetet är slutfört ansvarar du för att relevant dokumentation är uppdaterad och att lösningen kan lämnas över till driften på ett strukturerat sätt. Den löpande driften och övervakningen hanteras av en separat driftorganisation. När driften behöver stöd i mer komplexa ärenden bidrar du med fördjupad felsökning och specialistkompetens. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår bland annat att: Planera och förbereda nya eller förändrade nätverkslösningar Konfigurera nätverks- och kommunikationsutrustning Arbeta med routing, switching, VLAN och redundans Kvalitetssäkra konfigurationer och tekniska lösningar Genomföra tekniska kontroller och medverka vid driftsättning Analysera och felsöka komplexa problem Identifiera fel i gränslandet mellan IP-nätverk och transmission Samordna tekniska aktiviteter med interna tekniker och externa leverantörer Dokumentera konfigurationer, förändringar och genomförda åtgärder Genomföra en strukturerad överlämning till driften Ge specialiststöd till driften vid komplexa fel Kvalifikationer Det här tar du med dig in i rollen Vi söker dig som har några års praktisk erfarenhet av IP-nätverk, nätverksinfrastruktur eller närliggande kommunikationslösningar. Din erfarenhet kan komma från exempelvis datacom, telekom, en internetleverantör, ett stadsnät, datacenter, en NOC, offentlig verksamhet eller teknisk konsultverksamhet. Du kan i dag arbeta som exempelvis nätverksspecialist, nätverksingenjör, IP-specialist, datacom-specialist, nätverkskonsult eller i en annan kvalificerad roll inom nätverksinfrastruktur. Det är inte din nuvarande titel som är avgörande. Det viktiga är att du har en stabil praktisk IP-kompetens och kan ta ett självständigt ansvar för konfigurering, kvalitetssäkring och kvalificerad felsökning. För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har: Relevant utbildning inom nätverk, IT, telekom eller annat relevant tekniskt område, alternativt annan kompetens som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig Några års praktisk erfarenhet av IP-baserade nätverk Goda kunskaper inom routing och switching Erfarenhet av konfigurering och kvalificerad nätverksfelsökning Förståelse för VLAN, IP-adressering, nätsegmentering och redundans Förmåga att analysera tekniska problem och se samband mellan olika delar av kommunikationslösningen Erfarenhet av att dokumentera konfigurationer, förändringar och tekniska åtgärder Intresse för att arbeta inom och utveckla din kompetens inom transmission God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska B-körkort Personliga egenskaper Vi söker dig som är analytisk, ansvarstagande och noggrann och som vill förstå hur tekniska lösningar fungerar som helhet. Du arbetar metodiskt när du konfigurerar, kontrollerar och felsöker komplexa nätverkslösningar. Du kan strukturera ditt arbete, bedöma tekniska risker och säkerställa att lösningen håller rätt kvalitet innan den lämnas över till driften. Rollen innebär samarbete med bland andra tekniker, driftpersonal, specialister, beställare och leverantörer. Därför behöver du vara kommunikativ och prestigelös samt kunna skapa en gemensam förståelse för tekniska behov och lösningar. Du tar ansvar för att uppgifter blir genomförda, dokumenterade och överlämnade på ett tydligt sätt. Samtidigt delar du gärna med dig av din kunskap och tar hjälp när det behövs. Din vilja och förmåga att lära nytt är viktig. Du är motiverad att utveckla din kompetens inom transmission och omsätta nya kunskaper i praktiskt arbete. Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Meriterande Det är meriterande om du har CCNA eller motsvarande praktisk kunskapsnivå inom nätverk. Vi ser också positivt på erfarenhet eller kunskap inom ett eller flera av följande områden: Fiber, optik eller transmission WDM eller andra optiska transmissionslösningar Radiolänk eller andra transmissionsformer Redundanta nätverk och kommunikationsvägar Cisco, Juniper eller andra nätverksplattformar WAN-miljöer och geografiskt distribuerade nätverk Teknisk samordning med leverantörer eller entreprenörer Kvalificerad incident- och problemhantering Säkerhetskritisk eller samhällsviktig verksamhet Du behöver inte uppfylla samtliga meriterande delar. Din praktiska IP-kompetens, din felsökningsförmåga och din förmåga att ta tekniskt ansvar är viktigast i vår bedömning. Vi erbjuder Bakom Försvarsmaktens förmåga att leda, samverka och agera finns kommunikationslösningar som måste fungera när de behövs som mest. Som Nätverksspecialist bidrar du till att bygga och kvalitetssäkra robusta nätverk som Försvarsmaktens verksamhet kan lita på. Du använder din IP-kompetens från start, löser komplexa tekniska problem och utvecklar samtidigt en bredare förståelse för transmission, fiber och optik. Här får du utvecklas tillsammans med erfarna kollegor och bygga en eftertraktad kompetens inom både IP och transmission. Framför allt får du använda din tekniska kunskap i ett uppdrag som stärker Sveriges försvarsförmåga. Om FMTIS FMTIS ansvarar för att utveckla, förvalta, driva och underhålla delar av Försvarsmaktens IT- och telekommunikationslösningar. Här arbetar specialister, tekniker och chefer tillsammans för att skapa säkra, robusta och tillgängliga tekniska lösningar för Försvarsmaktens verksamhet. Som nätverksspecialist inom FMTIS får du möjlighet att utvecklas i en organisation där teknik, säkerhet och samhällsuppdrag går hand i hand. Responsibilities Own complex features and technical problems across the system, including cloud services, APIs, event-driven systems, web applications, IoT infrastructure, and occasionally the device edge. Turn loosely defined product or customer needs into technically detailed solutions. Understand the underlying problem, identify constraints, evaluate alternatives, challenge assumptions where necessary, and drive designs through implementation and production. Exercise sound product and engineering judgment. Look for elegant solutions, reduce unnecessary complexity, and maximize the work not done while still solving the customer's actual problem. Lead technical work through influence rather than authority by creating clarity, coordinating across engineers and teams, and helping the group converge on good decisions. Raise the effectiveness of the engineers around you through thoughtful code and design reviews, mentoring, pairing, technical discussion, and knowledge sharing. Work closely with Product, QA, firmware, security, operations, and other engineering teams. Communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Build software that can be operated successfully in the real world. Consider observability, failure modes, security, performance, cost, maintainability, and deployment strategy as part of the design rather than as afterthoughts. Contribute to the continuous improvement of our architecture, development practices, tooling, and engineering culture. Qualifications A BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. A Master’s degree is a plus. 6+ years professional software engineering experience and a track record of independently owning substantial technical problems from initial investigation through production. Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to become productive in unfamiliar technologies, codebases, and parts of the stack. Experience designing, building, and operating production distributed systems or cloud applications. Sound technical judgment. You can distinguish essential complexity from accidental complexity, make appropriate trade-offs, and move forward without requiring perfect information. Demonstrated ownership and initiative, with the ability to identify problems, create clarity, make decisions within scope, and drive work forward. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex systems, facilitate technical decisions, and respectfully challenge assumptions or direction when you believe there is a better approach. The ability and willingness to remain hands-on while helping other engineers succeed. Strong debugging and systems-thinking skills. When an abstraction, framework, or automated tool stops working, you can reason about what is happening underneath it. Valuable Experience The strongest candidates will bring several of the following: AWS or comparable public cloud platforms , particularly cloud-native architectures built around managed services. IoT or connected-device systems , including the realities of operating fleets of physical devices (intermittent connectivity, state synchronization, eventual consistency, idempotency, device identity, provisioning, certificate lifecycle, OTA updates, and fleet-scale observability). Production experience with TypeScript, Node.js, or comparable modern application-development technologies . Event-driven architectures , asynchronous workflows, message-oriented systems, and managed cloud data services. Infrastructure as code and automated cloud infrastructure management. Customer-facing surfaces , such as modern front-end frameworks (Angular, React, or comparable) and API design across GraphQL, REST, WebSockets, MQTT, or similar protocols. Production observability , incident investigation, distributed tracing, structured logging, and operational troubleshooting. Embedded C or C++ , or enough familiarity with embedded systems to work effectively across the firmware and cloud boundary. Mentoring engineers or informally leading small groups or technical initiatives. Applicants for this position must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. review_candidates.title: Senior Engineering Manager, EMEA
review_candidates.description: Company Overview: At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning, we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career. To enhance our team, we are seeking an experienced Senior Engineering Manager who brings strong people leadership, technical vision, and an AI-first operational strategy to our EMEA engineering organization. Position Summary: In this role, you will lead the technical strategy, organizational growth, and delivery execution for our engineering domain. As a Senior Engineering Manager , you drive technical strategy, organizational capability, and operational execution for video creation, upload, broadcast, processing, editing, and viewing systems that power video knowledge management for global universities and businesses. You will lead senior, staff, and principal engineers, aligning technical roadmaps with executive business objectives to build and scale distributed, high-performance systems supporting high reliability, system performance, and low latency. You will bridge high-velocity product delivery with robust engineering standards, ensuring our platforms are reliable, maintainable, and built on clarity over complexity. Driving an AI-first operational strategy, you will embed modern automation alongside agentic development environments (such as Claude Code) into engineering workflows, automated testing, and telemetry to eliminate repetitive tasks, accelerate delivery speed, increase pull request review speed without lowering code quality, and optimize engineering efficiency across complex software architectures. You'll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft. How You’ll Contribute: In this role, you will have the opportunity to… People Leadership & Organizational Design: Lead, develop, and mentor an engineering organization composed of senior, staff, and principal individual contributors. Build scalable team structures, establish clear career pathways, and drive workforce planning to increase engineering capacity. Technical Strategy & Roadmap Execution: Establish and execute technical roadmaps for distributed, high-performance systems. Drive architectural decisions that guarantee reliability, low latency, and system scalability. AI-First Operational Integration: Embed modern AI tools and automation into the engineering lifecycle. Use an AI-first approach to software development (e.g., AI-DLC) to accelerate team velocity and improve service resiliency. Cross-Functional Alignment & Stakeholder Management: Coordinate delivery and technical trade-offs with executive stakeholders, product leadership, and cross-functional teams. Translate complex technical concepts into clear business risks and opportunities. What Success Looks Like Within 3 Months: Complete onboarding across our codebases, build direct relationships with your team, evaluate current engineering workflows, and establish baseline AI-assisted tooling adoption. Within 6 Months: Optimize pipeline delivery velocity, standardize system observability metrics, and drive quarterly roadmap execution for key features. Within 1 Year: Establish a high-performing EMEA engineering unit, reduce platform incident resolution times through AI-driven telemetry, and deliver scalable infrastructure supporting core user growth targets. Your Legacy: Build a resilient, modern engineering organization and platform architecture that powers global video learning seamlessly for millions of daily users. Values in Action Customer First, Always: You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports. Thrive Together: You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people. Elevate the Craft: You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new. Act with Ownership: You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem. Clarity Over Complexity: You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication — internal or external — is direct, specific, and free of filler. How We Thrive You’ll work alongside a high-caliber group of engineers with deep domain expertise across cloud architecture, distributed systems, media processing, and DevOps. Your direct team is composed of seasoned senior, staff, and principal engineers who drive critical platform architecture, while you collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Infrastructure leaders to scale our global video platform. The Foundation for Success Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent industry experience combined with 8+ years of professional engineering experience on complex distributed systems, including 4+ years of direct people management experience leading senior, staff, or principal engineers. Proficiency with software development in languages such as Javascript, Python, C#, or Java, alongside architecture expertise in distributed, high-availability production environments. Applied experience leveraging modern AI-first engineering practices and agentic development environments (e.g., Claude Code) to increase team velocity. Join Us Join Panopto and play a key role in shaping the future of video creation and streaming for millions of users worldwide. If you love coaching engineering teams, leveraging AI-assisted workflows, and building high-performance, scalable video architectures, you’ll feel right at home here. Beyond The Requirements At this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description you’re reading. Even if you don't feel that you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We're eager to meet people that believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways - not just candidates who check all the boxes. We want people to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work here. Recruiting Tips: From crafting an impressive resume to presenting your best self during our interviews, we're dedicated to ensuring you feel well-prepared and self-assured as you embark on opportunities at Panopto. Discover some valuable recruiting tips from our team. The standard interview process at Panopto involves several steps, outlined below, to ensure we approach the process thoughtfully and consistently: Application Review -> Recruiter Call -> Video Interview & Assessment -> Hiring Manager Call -> Interview Loop -> Debrief -> Offer Job Applicant Privacy Notice (compliant with GDPR) As part of any recruitment process, Panopto collects and processes personal data relating to job applicants. The organization is committed to being transparent about how it collects and uses that data and to meeting its data protection obligations. What information do we collect? Panopto collects a range of information about you. This includes: your name, address and contact details, including email address and telephone number; details of your qualifications, skills, experience and employment history; information about your current level of remuneration, including benefit entitlements; whether or not you have a disability for which the organization needs to make reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process; and information about your entitlement to work in the UK Panopto may collect this information in a variety of ways. For example, data might be contained in application forms, CVs or resumes, obtained from your passport or other identity documents, or collected through interviews or other forms of assessment. We may also collect personal data about you from third parties, such as references supplied by former employers. We will seek information from third parties only once a job offer to you has been made and will inform you that we are doing so. Data will be stored in a range of different places, including on your application record, in HR management systems and on other IT systems (including email). Why does Panopto process personal data? We need to process data to take steps at your request prior to entering into a contract with you. We may also need to process your data to enter into a contract with you. In some cases, we need to process data to ensure that we are complying with its legal obligations. For example, it is mandatory to check a successful applicant's eligibility to work in the UK before employment starts. Panopto has a legitimate interest in processing personal data during the recruitment process and for keeping records of the process. Processing data from job applicants allows us to manage the recruitment process, assess and confirm a candidate's suitability for employment and decide to whom to offer a job. We may also need to process data from job applicants to respond to and defend against legal claims. Panopto may process special categories of data, such as information about ethnic origin, sexual orientation or religion or belief, to monitor recruitment statistics. We may also collect information about whether or not applicants are disabled to make reasonable adjustments for candidates who have a disability. We process such information to carry out its obligations and exercise specific rights in relation to employment. If your application is unsuccessful, Panopto may keep your personal data on file in case there are future employment opportunities for which you may be suited. We will ask for your consent before it keeps your data for this purpose and you are free to withdraw your consent at any time. Who has access to data? Your information may be shared internally for the purposes of the recruitment exercise. This includes members of the HR and recruitment team, interviewers involved in the recruitment process, managers in the business area with a vacancy and IT staff if access to the data is necessary for the performance of their roles. We will not share your data with third parties, unless your application for employment is successful and we make you an offer of employment. We will then share your data with former employers to obtain references for you, employment background check providers to obtain necessary background checks. How does Panopto protect data? We take the security of your data seriously. We have internal policies and controls in place to ensure that your data is not lost, accidentally destroyed, misused or disclosed, and is not accessed except by our employees in the proper performance of their duties. For how long does Panopto keep data? If your application for employment is unsuccessful, the organization will hold your data on file for 6 (six) months after the end of the relevant recruitment process. If you agree to allow us to keep your personal data on file, we will hold your data on file for a further 6 (six) months for consideration for future employment opportunities. At the end of that period, or once you withdraw your consent, your data is deleted or destroyed. You will be asked when you submit your CV whether you give us consent to hold your details for the full 12 months in order to be considered for other positions or not. If your application for employment is successful, personal data gathered during the recruitment process will be transferred to your Human Resources file (electronic and paper based) and retained during your employment. The periods for which your data will be held will be provided to you in a new privacy notice. Your rights As a data subject, you have a number of rights. You can: access and obtain a copy of your data on request; require the organization to change incorrect or incomplete data; require the organization to delete or stop processing your data, for example where the data is no longer necessary for the purposes of processing; and object to the processing of your data where Panopto is relying on its legitimate interests as the legal ground for processing If you would like to exercise any of these rights, please contact hr@panopto.com. If you believe that the organization has not complied with your data protection rights, you can complain to the Information Commissioner. What if you do not provide personal data? You are under no statutory or contractual obligation to provide data to Panopto during the recruitment process. However, if you do not provide the information, we may not be able to process your application properly or at all. Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI): Panopto may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in our recruitment and evaluation process. This may include analyzing resumes, assessing skills, and generating insights to help identify qualified candidates. Please be assured that AI tools are used to support our team, and all final hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. Panopto hiring teams will thoroughly review your application and assessment results. AI is not used to make final decisions regarding your candidacy. By submitting your application and participating in the recruitment process, you acknowledge and consent to Panopto's use of AI tools as described above. We are committed to full compliance with all applicable labor laws, including Equal Employment (EEOC) laws, across all our company entities. To ensure fairness and transparency: _ We have human oversight in all hiring decisions. _ If you have concerns regarding the use of AI in your assessment, please contact Panopto Talent Attraction to request a manual

review_candidates.title: Product Manager (Squad Lead)
review_candidates.description: If you want to lead a squad building the AI that runs the world's biggest infrastructure projects, join nPlan… Shape how the world's biggest infrastructure gets built — HS2, Heathrow, Sizewell C and more, where the decisions your product informs are measured in years and billions.† Build on world-class AI — the most accurate construction risk forecasting on the market, from a MacRobert Prize–finalist engineering and research team. Lead, and build, for real — run your own squad, plan its quarter, ship with your own hands (and your agents'), and take on more scope as fast as you can earn it. Ready to reshape one of the world's largest industries? nPlan has built a unique AI platform that turns the data behind major construction projects into decisions their leaders can act on — forecasting delay and cost risk on some of the world's most important infrastructure, and helping the people running those projects decide what to do about it. Behind that is a machine learning capability that forecasts project risk more accurately than anything else on the market — trained on one of the largest datasets of construction schedules in existence, and built by a world-class engineering and research team recognised as a MacRobert Prize finalist, the UK's top engineering award. As a PM here, that's what you get to build on — and the team you get to build alongside. The role — read this part carefully We don't run product management the way most companies do. AI has collapsed the cost of building software, so we've rebuilt how we work around a simple idea: when execution is cheap, judgment is the scarce resource. We organise into squads of 2–3 people, and everyone in a squad is a contributor. There is no "write the spec and wait," no design-and-handover. As a Product Manager at nPlan, you lead one or more of these squads. You're accountable for planning your squad's quarter: you own the mission, reconcile priorities when unplanned work lands, and have genuine authority to make trade-offs — including saying "not this quarter." And you build. You'll prototype with AI tools, direct agents, review and edit generated code, and take ideas to working tests in days, not weeks. Increasingly, the product itself is agents. Our direction is to move from tools that help people run projects to the AI that runs the project — agents that read what's happening on a programme, work out what matters, propose actions, and eventually act, with humans signing off rather than doing the legwork. You'll design these agents: what they do, what they must never do, and where the human stays in the loop when the consequences are measured in years and billions. And because you can't ship an agent you can't measure, evals sit at the centre of how we work. Nothing counts as done until a structured evaluation shows it's actually good. Squads don't own permanent territories. They have themes they align with, and each quarter they take on missions based on what nPlan needs most and what the squad is best equipped to deliver. The through-line across everything we build stays the same: helping the people who run major projects make better decisions when the stakes are high and the future is uncertain. What you'll do Own your squads' quarter: plan it, reconcile it against unplanned work and support demands, and deliver it. Make build/kill decisions on evidence, and know what value a piece of work will create — and how you'll measure it — before you build it. Build, not just brief: write clear specs, prompt agents effectively, and review and edit generated code and output rather than writing from scratch or handing over. Keep idea-to-test in days by choosing the cheapest path to a valid test. If you haven't touched an AI coding tool today, something's wrong. Design and ship AI agents: decide what an agent should do, what it must never do, and where the human stays in the loop. Shape the context, tools, and guardrails it works with, and own the trade-offs between model choice, prompting, retrieval, and UX. Run evals — this is central to what we do: define what good looks like before you build, then prove it with structured evaluations — representative datasets, scoring rubrics, and success metrics covering quality, cost, and reliability. An agent that demos well but doesn't improve real outcomes doesn't ship. Kill things fast when the evidence says so; we measure ourselves in outcomes shipped and experiments correctly killed. Help people decide under uncertainty: our products exist to help people act when the future isn't certain. You'll shape how we turn risk and forecasts into something a busy executive can make a confident call on. Get close to customers: run user and buyer research, sit in on client and sales meetings, and treat real customer feedback as your most valuable input. Our clients run multi-billion-dollar projects and carry real accountability for them; understanding their world is the job. Lead contributors, not a process: lead your squad to decisions and delivery with no handovers, coordinate dependencies with other squads, and spread what your squad learns through our guilds. Please mention the word 'crane' in your application. What we're looking for Two-plus years owning a B2B or enterprise AI or SaaS product — accountable for a product area, not tickets — with shipped, adopted features that real clients depend on. You already build with AI, daily: prototypes, analysis, working code you review and edit rather than write from scratch. You can go from idea to a working test without an engineer as intermediary. You've built with LLMs in earnest — enough to reason about model choice, prompting, context and retrieval, and tool use, and to know that an eval suite is what separates a good agent from a lucky demo. You can take an ambiguous problem, get to the heart of what customers actually need, and make the right calls — because you understand the trade-offs, not because you followed a framework. You've killed things. You can point to experiments you ran, what they told you, and the roadmap items that died as a result. You're fluent with data: you use it to find the problem worth solving and to know whether what you shipped actually worked — including designing structured evaluations, not just reading dashboards. You communicate sharply: you can make a complex trade-off legible to an engineer, a customer, and a member of the leadership team in the same afternoon. The problems are hard, the stakes are real, and the path isn't always clear — you're energised by that, not slowed down by it. Nice to have Experience with a product built on data science or machine learning, and comfort talking about forecasting, uncertainty, and probabilities. Experience selling or shipping to senior operational or finance buyers (the people accountable for large, complex programmes of work). Some understanding of the construction industry, planning, and/or risk. A formal technical background (development, engineering, or data). What working at nPlan will be like We are still a relatively small team, so there is plenty of opportunity for a high degree of ownership and growth over different areas of the product, and you will be directly exposed to all areas of the business. Meaningful equity — you're taking on real ownership, and we want you to share in what you help build. 🏄 Generous paid holiday, because time with the people and things you care about matters. 🕐 Flexible working hours and a flexible remote setup — into the Shoreditch office just 1–2 times per month (or as often as you'd like), plus quarterly company get-togethers. 🥯 Regular lunches, socials and opportunities to connect as a team. A Learning & Development budget, strong Health & Wellbeing support, and generous family leave. Your voice will always be heard. What you do or say counts, not who you are or where you're from. We are a cross-disciplinary team, and come from all backgrounds and cultures. We have three core values that underlie everything we do: Learn from Everything Be Radically Truthful Aim High, Run Fast These enable us to create a collaborative, inclusive environment where we can move effectively and efficiently to implement the best solutions. We are working hard to create a workplace that is inclusive to everyone, no matter their background, or where they are in life. We believe that only a truly diverse place can create great products that serve a wide audience and improve the world. We believe in equality of opportunities and that's why we make sure that these ideas are reflected in our values, and that we really apply these in all aspects of our company culture. If you have a need for any adjustments during our interview process, let us know and we will do our best to accommodate them. Hiring process Intro call (Product team member) (15 min) Skill set interview (Product Lead) (30 min) Practical exercise: prototype something with AI tools and show us how you'd eval it (Product Lead & squad member) (60 min) Values Alignment call (60 min) On-site (half a day, can be remote) If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

review_candidates.title: Technical Architect
review_candidates.description: Position Description At CGI, we help clients modernise complex technology estates with the insight and confidence needed to deliver change successfully. As a Technical Architect, working on one of our flagship accounts, on an application upgrade programme, you’ll create the reliable technical foundations that enable informed architecture decisions and successful application upgrades. You’ll take ownership of understanding existing application environments, rebuilding incomplete designs and establishing accurate technical baselines across the estate. Working closely with Solution Architects, Technical Leads and subject matter experts, you’ll have the opportunity to solve complex technical challenges and improve how architectural knowledge is captured and used. You’ll be supported by an experienced, collaborative team while having the autonomy to strengthen technical quality, reduce delivery risk and make a tangible contribution to a major transformation programme. CGI was recognised in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work List 2025 and has been named a UK ‘Best Employer’ by the Financial Times. We offer a competitive salary, excellent pension, private healthcare, plus a share scheme (3.5% + 3.5% matching) which makes you a CGI Partner not just an employee. We are committed to inclusivity, building a genuinely diverse community of tech talent and inspiring everyone to pursue careers in our sector, including our Armed Forces, and are proud to hold a Gold Award in recognition of our support of the Armed Forces Corporate Covenant. Join us and you’ll be part of an open, friendly community of experts. We’ll train and support you in taking your career wherever you want it to go. This is a hybrid position but there is an expectation of working at CGI and our Client’s offices in Glasgow for 3 days a week. Your future duties and responsibilities In this role, you will take ownership of reviewing, reconstructing and maintaining technical designs across a complex application estate. Working under the direction of the Application Upgrade Programme (AUP) Solution Architecture function, you’ll assess existing High Level Designs (HLDs), investigate gaps and inconsistencies, and work with technical specialists to establish an accurate picture of implemented application environments. You’ll bring structure and creative problem solving to situations where technical information is incomplete or outdated, capturing hosting, infrastructure, integrations, dependencies, security and operational characteristics. Supported by Solution Architects, Technical Leads and SMEs, you’ll create reliable technical baselines that strengthen governance, identify risks earlier and give programme teams the information they need to deliver application upgrades confidently. Review & Maintain: Assess and update HLDs and supporting technical documentation across the application estate. Reconstruct & Document: Rebuild technical designs where existing documentation is incomplete, inconsistent or unavailable. Discover & Analyse: Work with technical specialists to understand implemented application environments and establish the facts behind existing designs. Capture & Baseline: Document hosting, infrastructure, interfaces, integrations, dependencies, security and operational characteristics. Assure & Improve: Ensure technical documentation is accurate, consistent and sufficiently detailed to support architecture and delivery. Identify & Escalate: Recognise material architectural changes, discrepancies and technical risks and route them through the appropriate architecture governance. Collaborate & Influence: Build effective working relationships with Solution Architects, Technical Leads, SMEs and programme delivery teams. Enable & Deliver: Maintain reliable technical baselines that support informed decisions, programme governance and successful application upgrade milestones. Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role You’ll bring Technical Architecture experience within complex application environments, with the ability to understand existing systems and translate technical discovery into clear, accurate architecture documentation. You’ll combine strong analytical skills and attention to detail with a collaborative approach, taking ownership of technical information while drawing on specialists across the programme to establish reliable designs. Proven Technical Architecture experience within complex application or enterprise technology environments. Strong experience producing and maintaining technical architecture documentation, including High Level Designs. Ability to reverse-engineer or reconstruct technical designs from existing systems, stakeholder knowledge and incomplete documentation. Good understanding of application hosting and infrastructure, including the relationships between applications and their underlying technology. Strong understanding of interfaces, integrations and technical dependencies across application environments. Good awareness of security considerations within technical and application architecture. Understanding of operational and support requirements and how these influence technical design. Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly when working with incomplete or inconsistent technical information. Excellent attention to detail, with the ability to establish and maintain accurate technical baselines. Strong stakeholder and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with architects, Technical Leads, SMEs and delivery teams. Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because… You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction. Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise. You have a passion for new development and have a proven record of navigating the challenges in new product integration. The role focuses on delivering robust and reliable electronic systems for data handling, communications, and control across all mission phases. The engineer will contribute to system architecture definition, interface management, verification activities, and requirements engineering, while working closely with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. In this role, you might be assigned to different avionics systems of the spacecraft. Key Responsibilities System Design & Architecture Define and develop avionics system architectures, including electronics, data handling, and communication functions. Ensure end-to-end consistency of data flows, interfaces, and system-level requirements. Support selection and definition of avionics equipment, computing platforms, sensors, and communication hardware. Contribute to spacecraft-level trade-offs between performance, reliability, mass, power, and cost. Communications & Data Handling Define onboard and ground-related communication and data handling concepts. Support implementation of telemetry, telecommand, and data distribution architectures. Ensure reliable data acquisition, processing, storage, and transmission under mission constraints. Contribute to bandwidth, timing, and data budget analyses. Integration & Interface Management Define and manage interfaces between avionics and other spacecraft subsystems (power, propulsion, GNC, payload, etc.). Ensure compatibility between spacecraft, launch vehicle, and ground segment interfaces. Coordinate interface definitions with internal teams, suppliers, and external stakeholders. External Regulatory & Certification Leadership Strong ability to technically present, defend, and substantiate avionics subsystem designs and verification evidence with external regulatory and certification authorities, including NASA, ESA, and other government agencies, supporting spacecraft qualification, safety, and flight certification. Verification & Validation Define and support verification and validation strategies for avionics systems. Participate in simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and system-level testing activities. Analyze test results, identify anomalies, and drive corrective actions. Ensure compliance with system performance and reliability requirements. Requirements Engineering Capture, analyze, and manage system and subsystem requirements. Ensure full traceability from mission objectives to implementation and validation. Contribute to system documentation, including specifications, interface control documents, and test plans. Ensure compliance with applicable space standards and engineering best practices. Cross-functional Collaboration Work closely with software, hardware, systems, operations, and mission engineering teams. Participate in design reviews, technical exchanges, and system trade-off discussions. Support alignment with external partners, suppliers, and customers. Contribute to integration campaigns, launch preparation, and mission operations support. Required Qualifications Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent. +7 years experience in avionics systems, electronics, embedded systems, or spacecraft engineering. Strong understanding of: Electronic and embedded system architectures Communication and data handling principles System integration and interface management Experience with requirements engineering and system lifecycle development. Knowledge of verification and validation methods, including testing and simulation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work in multidisciplinary engineering environments. Preferred Qualifications Experience in spacecraft avionics or aerospace systems. Familiarity with space communication and data standards (e.g., CCSDS). new_matches.title: Nätverksspecialist inom IP och transmission
new_matches.description: IP-nätverk | Routing och switching | Kvalificerad felsökning | Transmission Vill du arbeta med IP och transmission i robusta kommunikationsmiljöer? Du har en stabil praktisk grund inom IP-nätverk och erfarenhet av routing, switching, konfigurering och teknisk felsökning. Nu vill du ta ett större tekniskt ansvar och bredda din kompetens inom transmission och fysisk telekominfrastruktur. Vi söker en Nätverksspecialist inom IP och transmission till FMTIS i Bålsta. Du arbetar med att förbereda, konfigurera, kvalitetssäkra och driftsätta robusta nätverks- och kommunikationslösningar. Rollen omfattar även transmission och samband mellan IP-nätverket och den underliggande infrastrukturen. Du behöver inte vara specialist inom både IP och transmission. Det viktiga är att du kan bidra självständigt inom IP-nätverk och har intresse och förmåga att utveckla en bredare kompetens inom transmission. Hos oss blir din tekniska kompetens en del av säkra och robusta kommunikationslösningar som har betydelse för Försvarsmaktens verksamhet och Sveriges försvarsförmåga. Varför den här rollen? Det här är en möjlighet för dig som vill arbeta kvalificerat med IP-nätverk och samtidigt utveckla din förståelse för hela kommunikationskedjan. Du kommer till en tekniskt komplex miljö där lösningarna behöver vara säkra, tillgängliga och robusta. För att skapa fungerande kommunikation behöver du kunna analysera hur routing, switching, nätsegmentering, redundans, förbindelser och transmissionslösningar samverkar. Rollen omfattar mer än löpande nätverksdrift. Du tar tekniskt ansvar för lösningen genom konfigurering, kvalitetssäkring, tekniska kontroller, driftsättning och dokumenterad överlämning till driftorganisationen. Du får använda din befintliga kompetens inom IP, routing, switching och felsökning från början. Genom praktiskt arbete, kunskapsutbyte och planerad kompetensutveckling får du även möjlighet att fördjupa din förståelse för exempelvis fiber, optik, kapacitet och redundanta kommunikationsvägar. Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter Som Nätverksspecialist arbetar du med att skapa de tekniska förutsättningarna för nya och förändrade nätverks- och kommunikationslösningar. Du planerar och förbereder tekniska lösningar samt samverkar med interna tekniker och externa leverantörer när nya nätverksplatser etableras eller befintliga lösningar förändras. En central del av arbetet är att konfigurera nätverks- och kommunikationsutrustning, ofta på distans från kontoret. Du arbetar bland annat med routing, switching, VLAN, IP-adressering, nätsegmentering och redundans. Du genomför tekniska kontroller, kvalitetssäkrar lösningen och medverkar vid driftsättning. När arbetet är slutfört ansvarar du för att relevant dokumentation är uppdaterad och att lösningen kan lämnas över till driften på ett strukturerat sätt. Den löpande driften och övervakningen hanteras av en separat driftorganisation. När driften behöver stöd i mer komplexa ärenden bidrar du med fördjupad felsökning och specialistkompetens. new_matches.description: If you want to lead a squad building the AI that runs the world's biggest infrastructure projects, join nPlan… Shape how the world's biggest infrastructure gets built — HS2, Heathrow, Sizewell C and more, where the decisions your product informs are measured in years and billions.† Build on world-class AI — the most accurate construction risk forecasting on the market, from a MacRobert Prize–finalist engineering and research team. Lead, and build, for real — run your own squad, plan its quarter, ship with your own hands (and your agents'), and take on more scope as fast as you can earn it. Ready to reshape one of the world's largest industries? nPlan has built a unique AI platform that turns the data behind major construction projects into decisions their leaders can act on — forecasting delay and cost risk on some of the world's most important infrastructure, and helping the people running those projects decide what to do about it. Behind that is a machine learning capability that forecasts project risk more accurately than anything else on the market — trained on one of the largest datasets of construction schedules in existence, and built by a world-class engineering and research team recognised as a MacRobert Prize finalist, the UK's top engineering award. As a PM here, that's what you get to build on — and the team you get to build alongside. The role — read this part carefully We don't run product management the way most companies do. AI has collapsed the cost of building software, so we've rebuilt how we work around a simple idea: when execution is cheap, judgment is the scarce resource. We organise into squads of 2–3 people, and everyone in a squad is a contributor. There is no "write the spec and wait," no design-and-handover. As a Product Manager at nPlan, you lead one or more of these squads. You're accountable for planning your squad's quarter: you own the mission, reconcile priorities when unplanned work lands, and have genuine authority to make trade-offs — including saying "not this quarter." And you build. You'll prototype with AI tools, direct agents, review and edit generated code, and take ideas to working tests in days, not weeks. Increasingly, the product itself is agents. Our direction is to move from tools that help people run projects to the AI that runs the project — agents that read what's happening on a programme, work out what matters, propose actions, and eventually act, with humans signing off rather than doing the legwork. You'll design these agents: what they do, what they must never do, and where the human stays in the loop when the consequences are measured in years and billions. And because you can't ship an agent you can't measure, evals sit at the centre of how we work. Nothing counts as done until a structured evaluation shows it's actually good. Squads don't own permanent territories. They have themes they align with, and each quarter they take on missions based on what nPlan needs most and what the squad is best equipped to deliver. The through-line across everything we build stays the same: helping the people who run major projects make better decisions when the stakes are high and the future is uncertain. What you'll do Own your squads' quarter: plan it, reconcile it against unplanned work and support demands, and deliver it. Make build/kill decisions on evidence, and know what value a piece of work will create — and how you'll measure it — before you build it. Build, not just brief: write clear specs, prompt agents effectively, and review and edit generated code and output rather than writing from scratch or handing over. Keep idea-to-test in days by choosing the cheapest path to a valid test. If you haven't touched an AI coding tool today, something's wrong. Design and ship AI agents: decide what an agent should do, what it must never do, and where the human stays in the loop. Shape the context, tools, and guardrails it works with, and own the trade-offs between model choice, prompting, retrieval, and UX. Run evals — this is central to what we do: define what good looks like before you build, then prove it with structured evaluations — representative datasets, scoring rubrics, and success metrics covering quality, cost, and reliability. An agent that demos well but doesn't improve real outcomes doesn't ship. Kill things fast when the evidence says so; we measure ourselves in outcomes shipped and experiments correctly killed. Help people decide under uncertainty: our products exist to help people act when the future isn't certain. You'll shape how we turn risk and forecasts into something a busy executive can make a confident call on. Get close to customers: run user and buyer research, sit in on client and sales meetings, and treat real customer feedback as your most valuable input. Our clients run multi-billion-dollar projects and carry real accountability for them; understanding their world is the job. Lead contributors, not a process: lead your squad to decisions and delivery with no handovers, coordinate dependencies with other squads, and spread what your squad learns through our guilds. Please mention the word 'crane' in your application. What we're looking for Two-plus years owning a B2B or enterprise AI or SaaS product — accountable for a product area, not tickets — with shipped, adopted features that real clients depend on. You already build with AI, daily: prototypes, analysis, working code you review and edit rather than write from scratch. You can go from idea to a working test without an engineer as intermediary. You've built with LLMs in earnest — enough to reason about model choice, prompting, context and retrieval, and tool use, and to know that an eval suite is what separates a good agent from a lucky demo. You can take an ambiguous problem, get to the heart of what customers actually need, and make the right calls — because you understand the trade-offs, not because you followed a framework. You've killed things. You can point to experiments you ran, what they told you, and the roadmap items that died as a result. You're fluent with data: you use it to find the problem worth solving and to know whether what you shipped actually worked — including designing structured evaluations, not just reading dashboards. You communicate sharply: you can make a complex trade-off legible to an engineer, a customer, and a member of the leadership team in the same afternoon. The problems are hard, the stakes are real, and the path isn't always clear — you're energised by that, not slowed down by it. Nice to have Experience with a product built on data science or machine learning, and comfort talking about forecasting, uncertainty, and probabilities. Experience selling or shipping to senior operational or finance buyers (the people accountable for large, complex programmes of work). Some understanding of the construction industry, planning, and/or risk. A formal technical background (development, engineering, or data). What working at nPlan will be like We are still a relatively small team, so there is plenty of opportunity for a high degree of ownership and growth over different areas of the product, and you will be directly exposed to all areas of the business. Meaningful equity — you're taking on real ownership, and we want you to share in what you help build. 🏄 Generous paid holiday, because time with the people and things you care about matters. 🕐 Flexible working hours and a flexible remote setup — into the Shoreditch office just 1–2 times per month (or as often as you'd like), plus quarterly company get-togethers. 🥯 Regular lunches, socials and opportunities to connect as a team. A Learning & Development budget, strong Health & Wellbeing support, and generous family leave. Your voice will always be heard. What you do or say counts, not who you are or where you're from. We are a cross-disciplinary team, and come from all backgrounds and cultures. We have three core values that underlie everything we do: Learn from Everything Be Radically Truthful Aim High, Run Fast These enable us to create a collaborative, inclusive environment where we can move effectively and efficiently to implement the best solutions. We are working hard to create a workplace that is inclusive to everyone, no matter their background, or where they are in life. We believe that only a truly diverse place can create great products that serve a wide audience and improve the world. We believe in equality of opportunities and that's why we make sure that these ideas are reflected in our values, and that we really apply these in all aspects of our company culture. If you have a need for any adjustments during our interview process, let us know and we will do our best to accommodate them. Hiring process Intro call (Product team member) (15 min) Skill set interview (Product Lead) (30 min) Practical exercise: prototype something with AI tools and show us how you'd eval it (Product Lead & squad member) (60 min) Values Alignment call (60 min) On-site (half a day, can be remote) If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

The old models of teaching and learning are in the midst of the largest transformation in history, and D2L is at the heart of that fundamental shift. New models of teaching and learning enable a personalized, student-centric experience – and deliver improved retention, engagement, satisfaction, and results for learners of all ages – in schools, campuses, and companies. D2L is disrupting the way the world learns, by providing the next generation learning environment and solutions to engage and inspire learners. And most importantly, by giving customers a platform that is easy, flexible, and smart. No other company provides a solution as robust and innovative as D2L. D2L has had a singular mission for 25 years and is dedicated to that same mission in the years ahead: to transform the way the world learns – and by doing so, we will help improve human potential globally. Every application we receive is personally reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team - yes, a real person looks at your resume! While we use AI tools internally to streamline tasks like meeting notes, summaries, and administrative work, these tools never rank resumes, make hiring decisions, or influence candidate evaluations. As a Proposal Writer, you will work in a high impact, fast-paced, deadline driven environment and will primarily be responsible for the creation of custom sales collateral for prospective and existing clients. This will include writing and project management in support of compelling and competitive custom documents. This role will require excellent writing, storytelling, communication, collaboration, time management, and project management skills. You will also support daily operations of the proposal team, implementing efficiencies, building resources that help stakeholders across D2L to support proposal efforts, assisting Proposal Managers on RFP responses, and supporting Team Leadership on operational improvements. Successful candidates will have a team player mindset, adaptability, a positive attitude, the ability to excel in a fast-paced environment, and a willingness to “do what it takes” to get the job done. How Will I Make an Impact?: Support D2L’s global Revenue organization by writing creative and compelling proactive / unsolicited proposals, pitch documents, presentation leave behinds, and other custom sales collateral that differentiates D2L from our competitors and helps generate new business. Manage creation of multiple sales documents on tight schedules and under elevated pressure. Perform writing and editing to ensure sales documents are interesting, compelling, succinct, and error-free. Enforce approved style guidelines and ensure a consistent look and feel of all outgoing documents. Contribute to the expansion and enhancement of the custom request program.] Identify opportunities for efficiencies (e.g., creating repeatable, self-serve templates) and enhanced productivity. Work cross functionally with subject matter experts within the organization to create sales documents while maintaining a technical understanding of D2L product and service offerings. Facilitate document reviews. Provide feedback on content library articles and contribute new content articles. Develop and cultivate strong relationships with relevant areas of the business to help strengthen partnerships and success within the team Review, edit, and provide guidance on the creation of cover letters, executive summaries, and other key parts of proposals as needed Work with other Proposal team members to create and improve best practices that ensure team operations are successful and efficient Manage and support operational activities (e.g., building how-to resources for team and other stakeholders across D2L, updating team templates, support content initiatives, etc.). Special projects as assigned. What You’ll Bring To The Role 2+ years’ experience in a fast-paced, high volume writing environment. Experience in high-tech industry is preferred. Experience writing persuasive documents an asset. Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office applications Ability to effectively use AI-enabled tools and emerging best practices to support proposal writing, content development, operational efficiency, and high-quality deliverables. Experience with proposal automation software considered an asset Ability to work independently and as part of a team; ability to adhere to strict deadlines Education Recommendations Bachelor’s Degree preferably in Business, Technical Writing, English, Communications, or Journalism The expected base salary range for a new hire in this role is listed below. The annualized base salary offered is determined by each candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, education, training and experience. It is aligned to ensure both internal and external competitiveness using market data for the geographic location and industry. As part of the total compensation at D2L the role may be eligible for additional benefits including a Wellness Subsidy, Equity Grants, Variable Incentive, and more. Base Salary Range £46,000—£60,500 GBP Don’t meet every single requirement? We strongly encourage you to still apply! At D2L, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. We encourage your application even if you don't believe you meet every single qualification outlined, because we love to help our people grow and develop! Why We're Awesome At D2L, we are dedicated to providing you with the tools to do the best work of your life. While some of our perks and benefits may vary depending on location or employment type, we are proud to provide employees with the following through : Impactful work transforming the way the world learns Flexible work arrangements Learning and Growth opportunities Tuition reimbursement of up to $4,000 CAD for continuing education through our SkillsWave Program 2 Paid Days off for SkillsWave-related activities like exams or final assignments Employee wellbeing (Access to mental health services, EFAP program, financial planning and more) Retirement planning 2 Paid Volunteer Days Competitive Benefits Package Home Internet Reimbursements Employee Referral Program Wellness Reimbursement Employee Recognition Social Events Dog Friendly Offices Spaces at our HQ in Kitchener, Winnipeg, Vancouver and Melbourne offices.

The company’s platform-based solutions are reinventing end-to-end travel management and the traveler experience for transient, meetings and workforce segments for Fortune 500 companies worldwide. Beyond cost savings HRS clients gain from an unrivaled focus on essential aspects including traveler satisfaction, risk mitigation and savings. HRS is also recognized for its award-winning Green Stay Initiative, technology that helps corporate hotel programs achieve their NetZero targets. HRS works with world’s leading hotel chains, regional hospitality groups and payment providers. You'll define and execute the go-to-market strategy for our meetings products, ensuring decision-makers across our ICP (Ideal Customer Profile) segments understand and adopt the value of the platform. You Will Lead the product marketing strategy for meetings and Connect, shaping how we engage the market and how our solution is perceived across geographies. Content: Build and manage impactful assets — thought leadership, digital content, use cases, product guides, webinars — tailored for meetings buyers. Competitive Intelligence: Provide insights into market trends, buyer needs, and competitive positioning to sharpen our messaging and innovation roadmap. Reporting: Track success metrics, gather feedback, and continuously optimize initiatives to maximize reach and revenue contribution. FOR THIS EXCITING MISSION YOU ARE EQUIPPED WITH... Go-to-Market Strategy Proven ability to develop and execute go-to-market strategies that drive adoption and revenue across international markets. Positioning And Value Proposition Expertise in crafting clear, differentiated value propositions that resonate with B2B decision-makers and reflect product innovation. Campaign And Content Execution Hands-on experience planning and delivering marketing campaigns, including messaging, content creation, and enablement materials. Sales And Marketing Collaboration Demonstrated ability to align sales and marketing activities, ensuring consistent messaging and seamless execution across functions. Market And Customer Understanding Proficiency in conducting market research, analyzing buyer needs, and adapting strategies to match customer expectations. Messaging And Communication Skills Strong written and verbal communication skills to convey product value across a variety of channels and audiences. Cross-Functional Collaboration Ability to work effectively with product, sales, and marketing teams to ensure launch readiness and ongoing alignment. Analytical And Data-Driven Decision Making Comfort using performance data and insights to optimize marketing efforts and support strategic planning. Our entrepreneurial-driven environment of full ownership and execution focus offers you the playground to contribute to a greater mission, while growing personally and professionally throughout this unique journey. You will continuously learn from a radical culture of retrospectives and continuous improvement and actively contribute to making business life better, smarter and more sustainable. LOCATION The position is based in Berlin, Germany. The attractive remuneration is in line with the market and, in addition to a fixed monthly salary, all necessary work equipment, will also include an annual or multi-year bonus. new_matches.description: About Staffbase We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform . Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees. Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience. Together, we're shaping the future of workplace communication. As our Principal, Partnership Management for Strategic Partners Europe, you'll own Staffbase's European Partnership Strategy end to end — from design through execution and cross-functional alignment. This is a senior, deeply relational individual contributor role with no shared ownership: the strategy will evolve with the market, but accountability for it sits with you. You won't be managing a broad portfolio or a scaled program. Instead, you'll focus scarce time and resources on a small number of high-impact strategic partners across Europe, building executive-level relationships that drive real commercial outcomes. We're looking for someone who thrives operating at that senior level — internally and externally — and brings conviction, focus, and follow-through to everything they own. We know strong candidates come in different shapes. If you've worked as a Partner Manager or in a similar partnership role and don't check every box, we'd still love to hear from you. What you'll be doing Strategy & Market Focus Own and continuously develop the European Partnership Strategy, aligned with leadership and key internal stakeholders. Lead DACH as the primary market, with France as an area of active momentum requiring immediate evaluation. Assess all other European markets for strategic investment potential, delivering clear recommendations to leadership by the end of 2026 and on an ongoing basis thereafter. Partner Relationships & Commercial Execution Own executive-level relationships with 5–10 strategic partners across Europe. Maintain regular in-person presence with each strategic partner Lead joint business planning, co-selling initiatives, and go-to-market execution with each partner. Ensure every strategic partner has access to the right Staffbase resources, knowledge, and internal contacts to succeed. Negotiate and manage individualized partner contracts starting Q3, with annual reviews. Evaluate smaller or emerging partners for strategic fit and provide investment recommendations to leadership — without managing them directly. Internal Alignment & Strategic Influence Act as the internal voice of European partnerships, influencing product, pricing, and go-to-market priorities based on partner feedback and market intelligence. Build alignment proactively so partnerships are taken seriously across the organization — not just when issues arise. Collaborate closely with Customer Success to identify service opportunities that can be routed to strategic partners, keeping that pipeline flowing consistently. Serve as the first escalation point for strategic partner issues, resolving problems before they escalate and owning the outcome regardless of root cause. Performance & Investment Decisions Own partnership KPIs — customer acquisitions, partner-sourced revenue, pipeline contribution, and partner engagement — tracked by market and partner. Provide leadership with clear, data-backed recommendations on where to invest, where to scale back, and where to exit. What you need to be successful Principal level experience in strategic partnerships, alliances, or enterprise business development, ideally in B2B SaaS A track record of owning executive-level relationships with partners and driving measurable commercial impact (revenue, pipeline, or acquisition) Experience developing and executing partnership or go-to-market strategy at a market or regional level Comfortable negotiating and managing individualized commercial agreements Strong cross-functional influence — you know how to align product, pricing, GTM, and Customer Success around a shared goal without formal authority over those teams Business fluency in German and English; additional European languages a plus Willingness and ability to travel regularly across Europe to maintain in-person partner relationships Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and ambiguity, and making judgment calls on where to focus time and resources What you'll get Competitive Compensation - we offer attractive salary packages including LTIP (unit-based Long Term Incentive Plan) Flexibility - we offer flexible working time models and the option of hybrid work, and support this with a yearly flex work allowance of €1560 Recharge - with 31 vacation days annually (incl. one floating holiday), plus pro rata fully paid Fridays off during August Support - we offer offering a company pension scheme Volunteers Day - you'll get one day off per year for supporting a social project
