new_matches.title: Commercial Specialist (OTA / Travel) - CEE market (f/m/x)
new_matches.description: The passion for traveling is what unites the entire eSky Group (eSky, eDestinos, Thomas Cook) . Our online travel agency was created by combining years of experience in the travel industry with a love for modern technology. We develop solutions that inspire people to explore the world and together, we turn these inspirations into experiences. We’re growing eSky Group’s presence across emerging CEE markets , and we’re looking for a CEE Commercial Specialist to support the region’s commercial performance across a portfolio of markets . You’ll help drive volume and margin delivery within the group yield framework, working closely with our Commercial, Product, Hotels, Aviation and Marketing teams. What will your journey with us look like? Commercial performance & market support Support delivery of bookings, margin, and revenue targets vs. forecast across assigned markets. Monitor ABV and margin performance weekly, flagging where results lag forecast and recommending corrective action. Build market-specific business cases for promotions or product changes, with a focus on ROI. Feed market-level insights and risk flags into central trading and forecasting teams. Competitive intelligence & market insight Run competitive intelligence tracking across assigned markets and surface findings to inform pricing decisions. Maintain an up-to-date view of competitive positioning and market trends, translating findings into commercial recommendations. Traffic & distribution Monitor traffic performance across organic and paid channels, working with Marketing to support CVR improvement. Support regional distribution partnerships, including affiliates and B2B2C codes. Flag gaps in traffic and distribution relative to market potential. Pricing & yield execution Execute pricing and yield actions as directed, within group-level frameworks. Adjust markup and pricing tactics to reflect local competitive landscapes and metasearch visibility. Feed regional demand signals and competitor intelligence back into commercial team. Reporting & insight Produce and maintain market-level reporting: ABV, conversion, margin and booking performance. Ensure reporting is timely, accurate, and actionable for stakeholders. Product & tech collaboration Represent local requirements such as payment methods and localisation needs, within the product roadmap. Flag product-related blockers that impact conversion or ABV. Work with product and tech teams to ensure commercial data needs are reflected in tools and platforms. Identify opportunities to use AI to work smarter and surface insights faster. To Succeed In This Role, You Need Experience in the travel or OTA industry: flights, hotels, or package holidays, ideally spanning more than one segment for CEE market, in a commercial, revenue, or pricing role. Experience contributing to market-level performance tracking: bookings, margin, ABV against forecast. Good commercial instinct: understanding of yield management, pricing tactics, and how distribution choices affect margin. Data-driven mindset: comfortable digging into performance data and turning it into clear, actionable recommendations. Exposure to traffic and distribution channels, including affiliates and B2B2C partnerships. Confidence working cross-functionally with commercial, marketing, and product teams. Comfortable in fast-moving, competitive markets, with an interest in market intelligence and competitor positioning. Fluent in English. Actively uses AI tools in daily work or is eager to start. Nice To Have Familiarity with metasearch dynamics and how they influence pricing decisions.

Wade International Airport including air traffic control, ground electronics, meteorological and aeronautical information services. On behalf of the Government of Bermuda, the Authority also oversees the performance of Skyport and its 30-year concession to operate, maintain and redevelop the airport. The Authority invites motivated and qualified applicants to join our team of dedicated professionals as an Air Traffic Engineering Technician . This role supports the operation of a range of facilities, systems and equipment including but not limited to communication, navigation, surveillance; electronic; detection; display; meteorological; and information and communications technology equipment, by carrying out preventative and corrective maintenance services. Also evaluates, troubleshoots, repairs, installs, modifies, commissions and de-commissions equipment as required.  Duties include but are not limited to: • Conducting daily inspections, performance tests, and maintenance activities for equipment and systems. • Reporting unusual occurrences or difficulties to the Maintenance Coordinator. • Enforcing safety protocols and maintaining a clean, hazard-free work area. • Assisting with on-the-job training programs. • Keeping the Maintenance Coordinator informed of unserviceable equipment, maintenance challenges, and spare parts requirements. • Completing installations of systems, equipment, and data processing tools. • Ensuring all ATE equipment operates to the satisfaction of its users. Education, Experience and Skills: • An Associate Degree or a City and Guilds Level 3 Diploma (or an equivalent recognized qualification) in Electronic Engineering or a related discipline. • A valid Driver’s License (light truck /manual). • A minimum of two years of recent and relevant experience. • Experience working in the aviation industry and in ILS, RADAR and or VOR/DME systems, is preferred. Additional Information: • Must meet the physical demands of the role. • Must be able to work rotating shifts, including weekends and public holidays, as assigned. • Must be willing and able to work additional hours and be on call for unexpected outages or service requests outside regular hours. • Administrator-level knowledge of Windows OS and a general understanding of other operating systems, applications, and software is preferred. Why Join Us: • Work in a critical aviation environment supporting international air traffic operations • Opportunity to gain experience and training across diverse CNS/ATM and meteorological systems • Be part of a small, highly skilled technical team with broad responsibilities • Attractive opportunity for candidates seeking international experience in Bermuda Shortlisted applicants may be required to go through a detailed vetting process and must be able to obtain a Skyport Restricted Airside Pass. Rund 280 Mitarbeitende entwickeln, fertigen und liefern hier hochwertige Sensorlösungen mit höchster Präzision. Moderne Büros, offene Begegnungszonen sowie großzügige Verpflegungs- und Erholungsbereiche schaffen ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit und Wissensaustausch fördert. Du willst internationalen B2B-Vertrieb nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv mitgestalten? Als Account Manager International nimmst du einen Schlüsselrolle an der Schnittstelle zwischen unseren internationalen Vertriebspartnern, Kunden und internen Fachbereichen ein. Du analysierst Marktpotenziale und Kundenbedürfnisse in verschiedenen Industriesegmenten und leitest daraus Vertriebs- und Wachstumsstrategien ab. Du koordinierst und leitest internationale Kundenprojekte in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Vertriebspartnern, Endkunden und internen Fachbereichen. Du erstellst Kalkulationen und Angebote, führst Preis- und Vertragsverhandlungen und verantwortest die Pflege individueller Preisvereinbarungen. Du überwachst die Performance deiner Accounts anhand definierter KPI's und leitest geeignete Maßnahmen zur Geschäftsentwicklung ein. Du prüfst kundenindividuelle Verträge gemäß den Baumer Richtlinien und stellst eine professionelle Vertragsabwicklung sicher. Du identifizierst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und treibst den Ausbau der Marktanteile in Deinen Vertriebsregionen voran. Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation Erste Berufserfahrung (ca. 2–3 Jahre) im internationalen Vertrieb oder Account Management Sehr gute Deutsch und Englischkenntnisse um mit den internationalen Kunden zu kommunizieren Proaktive Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsstärke Kundenorientierte, strukturierte und analytische Arbeitsweise Begeisterung für internationale Märkte und den Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen Bei uns findet Zusammenarbeit dort statt, wo Ideen entstehen: gemeinsam vor Ort. En goFLUENT estamos buscando un/a B2B Key Account Executive para desarrollar el mercado colombiano desde Bogotá , combinando estrategia comercial, prospección, negociación y construcción de relaciones con grandes organizaciones. No buscamos únicamente a alguien que venda. Buscamos a una persona capaz de entender los retos de negocio de sus clientes, generar conversaciones estratégicas y demostrar cómo una solución de aprendizaje puede transformar una organización. 🌎 ¿Por qué goFLUENT? En goFLUENT estamos transformando la manera en que las empresas desarrollan las habilidades lingüísticas y de comunicación de sus equipos. Somos una compañía tecnológica de origen suizo, con 26 años de experiencia , presencia internacional y un equipo global de más de 1.000 colaboradores . Nuestra plataforma combina tecnología, contenido y aprendizaje personalizado para ayudar a organizaciones de todo el mundo a desarrollar talento y eliminar las barreras que genera el idioma. Trabajarás en un entorno verdaderamente internacional, colaborando con equipos y profesionales de diferentes países y culturas, mientras desarrollas el mercado colombiano. 📍 Tu lugar de trabajo: Bogotá Formarás parte de nuestro equipo en la oficina de goFLUENT en Bogotá , un espacio diseñado para fomentar la colaboración, el intercambio de ideas y la conexión entre nuestros equipos. La oficina será tu punto de encuentro con colegas de diferentes áreas, especialmente Sales, Business Development, Marketing y Customer Success , creando un ambiente donde podrás aprender, compartir buenas prácticas y construir relaciones profesionales. Además, tendrás la oportunidad de interactuar con nuestra comunidad global y formar parte de una compañía con equipos distribuidos alrededor del mundo. 🎯 ¿Cuál será tu misión? Tu principal objetivo será hacer crecer el negocio de goFLUENT en Colombia , identificando nuevas oportunidades, desarrollando relaciones estratégicas y convirtiendo prospectos en clientes. Serás responsable de gestionar el ciclo comercial, desde la prospección y generación de oportunidades hasta la negociación y cierre. Tus principales responsabilidades 🚀 Desarrollar el mercado colombiano mediante prospección estratégica, identificación de nuevas cuentas y generación de oportunidades de negocio. 🔎 Identificar y conectar con tomadores de decisión, influenciadores y stakeholders, incluyendo perfiles de alta gerencia y C-level. 💬 Comprender los desafíos de negocio de cada prospecto y liderar conversaciones comerciales consultivas, cuestionando los enfoques tradicionales de aprendizaje. 💡 Presentar soluciones de goFLUENT de manera estratégica, conectando nuestras capacidades con las necesidades reales del cliente. 📊 Construir business cases y argumentos de ROI que demuestren el impacto y valor de nuestras soluciones. 🤝 Desarrollar relaciones de largo plazo con cuentas estratégicas y construir una sólida red de contactos. 🔄 Trabajar de manera cercana con Business Development, Marketing y Customer Success para maximizar las oportunidades comerciales. 🎤 Representar a goFLUENT en ferias, eventos, conferencias y actividades comerciales relevantes para el mercado colombiano. ✈️ Realizar visitas a clientes y prospectos dentro del territorio asignado cuando sea necesario. 📈 Gestionar tu pipeline comercial con autonomía, disciplina y un fuerte enfoque en resultados. 🧩 ¿Qué buscamos? Buscamos un perfil comercial con mentalidad hunter , ambición y capacidad para desenvolverse en conversaciones de negocio de alto nivel. Requisitos 2+ años de experiencia en ventas B2B, preferiblemente en venta consultiva. Experiencia en SaaS, tecnología, servicios corporativos o soluciones para empresas será altamente valorada. Experiencia trabajando con ciclos de venta complejos y múltiples stakeholders. Capacidad para desarrollar relaciones con gerentes, directores y C-level. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, presentación, negociación y storytelling comercial. Perfil proactivo, autónomo, resiliente y orientado a resultados. Capacidad para trabajar en ambientes dinámicos y multiculturales. Manejo profesional de LinkedIn y redes sociales para desarrollar networking y oportunidades comerciales. Experiencia en L&D, e-learning, HR Tech, capacitación corporativa o servicios de RR. HH. será un plus. Inglés mínimo B2, tanto oral como escrito. Español fluido. 💙 ¿Qué encontrarás en goFLUENT? Más que un trabajo de ventas, encontrarás una oportunidad para crecer dentro de una compañía global y desarrollar una carrera comercial internacional. 🌍 Ambiente verdaderamente internacional, trabajando con equipos de diferentes países y culturas. 🚀 La experiencia y estabilidad de una empresa suiza con más de 25 años, combinada con una cultura dinámica y orientada al crecimiento. 📚 Onboarding completo y acompañamiento para ayudarte a alcanzar tus objetivos desde el inicio. 💻 Acceso a nuestra plataforma de aprendizaje y la oportunidad de aprender uno de nuestros 49 idiomas de negocios. 💰 Paquete de compensación competitivo, con alto potencial de crecimiento asociado al desarrollo del mercado. 🤝 Colaboración directa con equipos de Sales, Marketing, Business Development y Customer Success. 🌎 Exposición a una organización global y oportunidades de colaboración internacional. 🎉 Actividades de integración, team building y una cultura que fomenta la colaboración. ✈️ Posibilidad de interactuar con nuestros equipos y oficinas internacionales. 🌟 ¿Estás listo/a para el reto? Si eres una persona comercial que disfruta abrir puertas, generar conversaciones de alto nivel, construir relaciones y cerrar negocios , esta puede ser tu próxima gran oportunidad. Únete a goFLUENT y ayúdanos a transformar la forma en que las organizaciones desarrollan el talento a través del aprendizaje. Conoce más sobre nuestra cultura y las historias de nuestro equipo a nivel global: Conoce goFLUENT Careers Sé parte de nuestro equipo en Bogotá y vive la experiencia goFLUENT desde una de nuestras oficinas clave en Latinoamérica. Nuestra oficina en Bogotá es mucho más que un lugar de trabajo: es un espacio donde las ideas se convierten en oportunidades, el talento se conecta y las personas crecen juntas . Aquí tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar junto a profesionales apasionados por las ventas, el aprendizaje y la innovación, en un ambiente colaborativo, dinámico e internacional. Serás parte de un equipo que trabaja conectado con colegas y clientes de diferentes partes del mundo, llevando desde Colombia el impacto de goFLUENT a organizaciones de todo el país.

new_matches.title: Staff Software Engineer
new_matches.description: This role is based in the United Kingdom. You will be required to interview in person. About SailPoint SailPoint is defining the next era of identity security. Our unified, AI-powered platform seamlessly secures both the Human Fabric of your workforce and the Agentic Fabric of AI and non-human identities, completely eliminating organizational blind spots. Built on core principles like zero-standing privilege and contextualized risk, our platform transforms identity from a vulnerability into a strategic business advantage. Today, we are trusted by some of the largest, most complex organizations in the world to deliver intelligent, autonomous identity security at scale. About the role. As a Staff Software Engineer at SailPoint, you will architect, build, and deliver high-performance cloud services that form the core decision-making brain of our identity platform. In this role, your day-to-day will involve designing resilient full-stack solutions using Golang and Angular, engineering synchronous and event-driven microservices, and pioneering AI-assisted and agentic development workflows. You will collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, architects, and global engineering peers to translate complex identity governance concepts into performant, elegant, and secure production systems. You will also take active ownership of technical excellence across our codebase through architecture reviews, system profiling, and developer mentorship. About the team You will join the UK Platform Engineering team, a collaborative, high-velocity group responsible for designing, building, and running foundational services for SailPoint. Our team currently features a strong mix of backend and frontend specialists transitioning to end-to-end full-stack development to support cutting-edge AI and identity initiatives. We value autonomy, continuous learning, and close teamwork, staying connected through day-to-day collaboration and meeting in person once per quarter for team offsites. Roadmap for success 30 days: Complete SailPoint engineering onboarding, development environment setup, and security compliance training. Shadow team members to understand the architecture, API contracts, and deployment pipelines of the Policy Engine. Deliver your first bug fix or minor feature contribution to production using Golang or Angular. 60 days: Partner with technical leads, architects, and product managers to define technical specifications and rough estimates for upcoming roadmap items. Build, test, and deploy end-to-end features supporting real-time and batch policy evaluation workflows. Conduct thorough code reviews and collaborate with peers on unit and integration testing strategies. 6 months: Lead the autonomous design, implementation, and deployment of complex features across the Policy Engine and SailPoint Agentic Fabric. Establish debug and performance profiling benchmarks to improve service latency, throughput, and reliability. Participate in the 24x7 engineering on-call support rotation (approximately 1 week in 20) and drive operational improvements. 1 year: Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on Policy Engine services and distributed system architecture. Mentor and coach junior and mid-level software engineers on modern software design patterns, Golang, Angular, and AI-assisted tooling. Drive cross-functional architectural initiatives in collaboration with engineering teams worldwide as the platform scales. Requirements Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience 8+ years of professional software development experience Proven expertise in backend microservice design and development, preferably using Golang Strong experience developing modern web frontends, preferably using Angular Solid foundation in automated testing and debugging, including unit, integration, and performance profiling tools Experience designing and maintaining scalable microservices within a distributed SaaS cloud environment Excellent collaboration, problem-solving, and communication skills Preferred Skills & Tech Stack Tech Stack: Golang, Angular, Java, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudBees/Jenkins Hands-on experience with cloud databases such as Amazon DynamoDB, Aurora, or Snowflake Experience building data streaming and event-driven architectures with Apache Kafka or Apache Flink Experience or strong interest in AI-assisted software development and agentic engineering practices Benefits At SailPoint, we empower businesses to take control of identity security—and we do the same for our people. Whether you're engineering solutions, advising customers, or accelerating business growth, you’ll expand your skills, collaborate with top talent, and grow with purpose. Benefits are dependent upon your country location however SailPoint provides: Competitive pay Medical, dental and vision plans Paid Holidays Career and growth opportunities SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law. Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact applicationassistance@sailpoint.com or mail to 11120 Four Points Dr, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78726, to discuss reasonable accommodations. NOTE: Any unsolicited resumes sent by candidates or agencies to this email will not be considered for current openings at SailPoint.
